home.hero_subtitle: Of Professor Cheikh Ahmet Tidiane KEBE
home.professor_bio: Founder of KEBE Islamic Legal Services (KSJI), graduate of the Mohammed VI Institute in Rabat and of the Khaly Amar Fall African Islamic University. With a French-Arabic education, he has been teaching, advising and providing religious mediation for more than 20 years.
home.career_1: 2025–…: Master's in Jurisprudence & Usul al-Fiqh (in progress)
home.career_3: 2017–2019: Diploma from the Mohammed VI Institute (Rabat)
home.responsibilities_text: Technical adviser at the PSE (2023–2024), Secretary of the SESA SAFIA Compliance Board (since 2025), Head of the Religious Desk at Malikia TV, Director of Arabic Studies, and active member of several scientific committees (Gamou of Tivaouane, COSKAS, Al Fatikh, PROJET).
home.quote_translation: “Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim”

downloads.help_title: Where can I find my downloads?
downloads.iphone_text: Open the “Files” app → “Browse” → “Downloads” (in iCloud Drive or “On My iPhone”). In Safari, the ⬇ icon at the right of the address bar also shows the list of downloads.
downloads.android_text: Open the “Files” (or “My Files”) app → “Downloads” / “Download” folder. In Chrome: menu ⋮ → “Downloads”.
downloads.computer_text: Files are in your “Downloads” folder. In the browser: Ctrl + J (Windows) or ⌥ + ⌘ + L (Mac).
downloads.videos_note: YouTube shows cannot be downloaded: they are watched online.
